messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — FastLane onboarding hitting handshake 429s during SDK init in eu-west-1. Customer report: "init fails ~30-60s after first try". Logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T13:46:11Z FastLane SDK init: POST /v1/init 429
retry 1 -> 401, retry 2 -> 429
```
Can eng take a look? This is on customer-facing prod; renewal call Monday could be impacted.

onboard-bot: Ticket CS-4832 created and assigned to #eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/CS-4832 :white_check_mark:

Ben: pinging infra. Thx Aisha. Two quick Qs — can you paste sample init request headers (auth type) and which SDK (node/python)? Also any SDK version? Sometimes preflight parallelism spikes.

Aisha: Node SDK v1.4.2, using ephemeral JWTs (ttl=60s). Sample headers:
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (ephemeral)
X-Client-Id: fastlane-prod
User-Agent: fastlane-node/1.4.2
```
Client does 8 parallel init requests on cold start.

Carlos: I see correlated spikes from the client pool — a classic handshake fanout. Ephemeral ttl=60s + 8 parallel preflight = thundering herd. Server side we return 429 when token validation queue > 200. Suggest these options:
- increase client token ttl to 300s temporarily
- or reduce parallelism to 2
- or we can apply a temporary customer-scoped rate bump for 24h (ops)

Devon: Customer is a mid-market account. If we don't stabilize before their renewal review Monday they may push back. Recommend we offer a short enablement session to walk them through SDK config, and agree to the temporary quota bump while they patch.

Ben: I can push a small server-side throttle-splay fix: add a 200ms jitter + queueing so sudden bursts don't flip to 429 immediately. Can do hotfix today, but need approval for a short capacity window.

Aisha: Please proceed with hotfix if it's low risk. I'll ask CS ops to approve temporary +10% quota for FastLane. Also setting up enablement call Thu 10am PT — invite sent.

onboard-bot: CS-4832 comment: 'Ben proposed jitter hotfix; Dev to approve + ops quota bump' — updated watchers.

Carlos: Quick SDK-side patch we can recommend to customer asap: set
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({maxInitConcurrency: 2, tokenTtl: 300});
```
Also add exponential backoff on init: 100ms * 2^n, max 2s.

Ben: I'll post the hotfix PR and link it here when ready. If we get +ops quota approved I'll flip feature flag for FastLane.

Aisha: Thanks all — noted follow-ups: (1) Ben: PR + link (2) Ops: +10% quota (3) Devon: enablement call prep + checklist. I'll log renewal risk in the account tracker. :point_up:
